points.text: MASKE AS is registered as aksjeselskap (AS) based in Trondheim, registered under 'Engroshandel med andre husholdningsvarer', founded 1995-06-28.
What it does (per its website): Maske AS lagerfører over 12000 forbruksartikler - kontor, datarekvisita, tørk, renhold, catering, emballasje, belysning, skole og helse - Tiller og Vinterbro.
Latest filed accounts (2025): revenue 1.5B NOK, operating result 83.7M, net result 66.5M; revenue up 2% vs 2024 (calculated).
Leadership: Daglig leder: Per Øivind Gundersen; Styrets leder: Jens Thurøe.
11 registered workplace(s): Bergen, Gloppen, Kongsvinger, Molde, Namsos, Sandefjord, Tromsø, Trondheim.
Verified website: https://www.maske.no/ (organisation number in the site's own identity block (footer, contact/about page or structured data)).
Recent official register changes: 2026-10-14 registered employees; 2026-09-15 registered employees; 2026-08-13 registered employees.
